# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We participate in this project with direct, technical, good-faith conduct.
Harassment, personal attacks, and private-information leaks are not accepted.

## Expected behavior

- Keep criticism about the code, docs, tests, or process.
- Give enough detail that another person can reproduce a problem.
- Assume public comments may be read by future contributors.
- Stop a thread when a maintainer says the issue has enough information.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment or threats.
- Sexualized language or imagery.
- Publishing private information without explicit permission.
- Repeated off-topic comments after a maintainer has redirected the thread.
- Abuse of issue templates, discussions, or security reporting.

## Reporting

Report conduct issues through GitHub private vulnerability reporting if public
discussion would expose private details. Otherwise, open a public issue with the
minimum detail needed for maintainers to act.

Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove comments and may block accounts when
needed to keep the project usable.
